text: What if Stickman drew a pause button?
A bird froze in midair. A soccer ball stopped one inch from a window.
The whole world was on hold.
Stickman grinned. He borrowed a fry from a frozen dog, and gave a pigeon tiny sunglasses.
Then he pressed the button again. Nothing happened.
So he drew a play button.
The ball smashed the window. The pigeon hit a lamp post. And the dog wanted its fry back.
Stickman ran, grabbed his pencil, and drew... a pause button.
